notes: Japanese statutory page titles expand into Kannada explanations of the Japanese law names; long page headings wrap. The pages keep their draft notices; the Japanese originals stay on the Japanese pages.

Generated names use the default order (generatedNames unset): first part, space, second part. Kannada puts the modifier before the noun and adjectives do not inflect, so every pair reads naturally (ಗುಡುಗಿನ ಶಿಖರ, ಕಬ್ಬಿಣದ ದ್ವಾರ, ಅವಳಿ ಹುಲಿ).

Kannada past-tense verbs show gender; players and {name} take the gender-neutral honorific plural (ಸೇರಿದ್ದಾರೆ, ಗೆದ್ದರು) or noun phrases. No case suffix attaches to a placeholder; a following noun (ಕಟ್ಟಡ, ಅವರ) or a colon carries it.
Plural category one covers 0 and 1 in Kannada; the one branches read correctly for 0.
Kage is written ಕಗೆ (both Japanese vowels short); ಕಾಗೆ would read as the Kannada word for crow.
ZWNJ appears only where Kannada spelling uses it in loanwords (ಅಪ್‌ಗ್ರೇಡ್, ಆನ್‌ಲೈನ್).
Actual player names, authored chat, technical IDs and provider-owned sheets are outside automatic translation.
